    Good signs for gentle algebras #

    For a gentle algebra there are sign functions such that a composable pair of arrows a b is nonzero exactly when σ b ≠ ε a (exists_good_signs). For such signs an adjacent pair of letters is allowed exactly when the signs alternate (allowedPair_iff).
